Creating the eivGP R package eivGP authors 2026-09-03 1 Literate package source The explicitly ordered .Rmd chapters are the authoritative package-building source for eivGP. Their maintained computational payload is kept under script/newly-written-and-modified-scripts/; every chapter identifies and copies one coherent module into the generated package. Historical R scripts are clearly separated under script/legacy-code-scripts/. The package book never launches publication-scale computation. Standalone reproduction documents live under experiments/ and applications/; they call the same exported package functions used by scripts and downstream users. Render and check the package from the repository root with: litr::render("index.Rmd") devtools::check("eivGP", document = FALSE)

3 Core utilities and frozen data Deterministic parallel mapping, validation helpers, and versioned synthetic datasets are shared by both scientific engines.

4 Study I engine Study I uses a single latent continuous input deterministically thresholded into one ordinal factor. The module contains its posterior engine, prediction targets, data-generating mechanism, baselines, and scoring rules.

5 Study II engine Study II uses multiple noisy ordinal proxies for a shared multivariate latent state. This module contains the ordinal-probit posterior engine, exact prospective latent simulation, prediction targets, diagnostics, baselines, and design generators.

6 Published competitors The UC-GP, LVGP, and EzGP adapters use the public package implementations and record package versions, optimization attempts, and predictive uncertainty. They remain optional dependencies and are required only for strict publication runs.

7 Stable model API Users fit either scientific engine through fit_eivgp(), predict supported statistical targets through predict_eivgp() or predict(), and obtain latent input draws through impute_eivgp(). Published competitors have matching package-facing wrappers. utils::globalVariables(c( "block", "chain", "chain_label", "count", "draw", "ess", "global_u_accept_total", "global_u_eval_total", "global_u_total", "ref", "rhat", "theta_eval_total", "theta_update_total", "u_ess_accept_total", "u_ess_eval_total", "rank_bin", "u_ess_total", "value", "xintercept" ))

8 Compatibility experiment API run_mixedgp_experiment() is retained for existing examples and historical workflows. The paper’s frozen publication design uses the newer study-specific runners in the next chapter.

9 Publication simulation API The current publication workflow has one configuration constructor and one runner per study. Configurations freeze design cells, seeds, eligible methods, MCMC controls, checksums, and diagnostic gates. Both runners default to a read-only dry run. Smoke and publication fits automatically run the exact published-competitor and paired-design validators before data generation or fitting. External competitor failures are retained as auditable status records without preventing EIV-GP MCMC; the EIV-GP convergence gate remains mandatory. The exact scripts hashed and sourced by the publication engine are installed with the package. This preserves the same source-identity checks when eivGP is called outside a development checkout. Validator outputs and their status are written under the fingerprinted run’s config/ directory. fit <- eivGP::fit_eivgp( X, y, C, U_obs, engine = "multivariate", latent_dim = 2L, kernel = "matern" ) mean_draws <- eivGP::predict_eivgp( fit, new_X = X_new, new_C = C_new, target = "mean" ) response_draws <- predict( fit, new_X = X_new, new_C = C_new, target = "response" ) latent_draws <- eivGP::impute_eivgp(fit, new_C = C_new)

10 Real-data interface The real-data layer accepts arbitrary numeric predictors, ordinal proxies, and an optional sparse calibration matrix. It exposes no data download or hidden path behavior. The developing application has a standalone R Markdown file under applications/ and will remain separate from the simulation studies.

11 Package tests The canonical test file exercises public validation, fitted-object contracts, prediction targets, deterministic parallel behavior, frozen-data integrity, and installed experiment resource discovery.

12 Documentation Documentation and the namespace are generated only after every canonical module and test resource has been installed. Run the full package check separately so the literate render cannot launch or mask a check failure: study1 <- eivGP::run_study1_simulation( eivGP::study1_simulation_config(mode = "publication", workers = 8L) ) study2 <- eivGP::run_study2_simulation( eivGP::study2_simulation_config(mode = "publication", workers = 8L) )
